compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Sterile Processing Technician-PRN
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: NYC Joint & Spine Center- Englewood Address: 34 S Dean Street, Suite 201, Englewood, NJ 07631 Website: https://nycjointspine.com/ NYC Joint & Spine Center is a leading outpatient surgical facility focused on orthopedic, spine, plastics, podiatry and total joint care. With two well-equipped operating rooms and a collaborative clinical environment, our team delivers efficient, patient-centered care for individuals seeking high-quality surgical treatment close to home. Location is in partnership with Compass Surgical Partners, an ASC Management organization. Role Summary: The Central Processing Sterile Technician is responsible for cleaning, sterilizing, assembling, and storing surgical instruments and equipment. This role ensures the operating team has the tools needed for safe, effective patient care, directly supporting the perioperative process and overall patient safety Hours: - Monday–Friday schedule, PRN (hours vary) - No nights, weekends, holidays, or call What You’ll Do: - Clean, inspect, sterilize, and package instruments and equipment according to standards - Assemble instrument trays and maintain accurate labeling and storage - Operate sterilizers, washers, and related equipment safely and effectively - Monitor and maintain sterile supply inventory; check for outdated or compromised items - Support patient safety, infection prevention, and quality improvement initiatives - Communicate effectively with teammates, physicians, and other staff - Maintain a clean, orderly, and compliant sterile processing work area What You’ll Bring: - High school diploma or GED required - Prior experience in sterile processing required - CBSPD or IAHCSMM certification preferred (or ability to obtain within 18 months of hire if required) - Current BLS certification - Strong attention to detail, teamwork, and communication skills Physical & Work Environment Requirements: - Frequent standing, walking, and lifting - Occasional stooping, kneeling, or climbing - Ability to lift/move up to 50 lbs (occasionally up to 100 lbs) - Regular exposure to bloodborne pathogens, chemicals, and sterilization equipment in a fast-paced environment Compensation & Benefits: - Competitive hourly rate (based on experience and qualifications) - Healthcare benefits package - 401(k) with company match - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Supportive, collaborative, and growing environment Why Compass Surgical Partners? Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com.

embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:9a935d1.title: Enterprise Marketing Lead
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:9a935d1.description: About FLORA We are building the first creative operating system: an infinite canvas designed for the generative computing paradigm. We’re a team of ~45 focused on elevating professional craft, backed by tier-one investors including Redpoint, Menlo Ventures, and a16z, as well as founders like Guillermo Rauch and Justin Kan. Our platform is already the choice of world-class creative powerhouses like Pentagram, Lionsgate, and Nike. About the role This is a true 0-1 role, and FLORA’s first enterprise-focused marketing role. It’s a dream role for the person who loves building, knows how the enterprise buying process works, and wants free reign to experiment their way to growth. FLORA has product-market fit, real inbound interest from our enterprise ICP, and an amazing sales team ready to move. We are looking for someone to build the marketing infrastructure to turn that signal into a repeatable, compounding pipeline. As FLORA's first Enterprise Marketing & Ops hire, you'll own both sides of that equation: the programs that generate demand and the operational foundation that makes every program measurable and scalable. You'll work directly alongside Sales, RevOps, and Growth teams to define what enterprise GTM looks like a category-defining company. What you’ll do - Design and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns (email, paid, outbound sequences, and content) that move target accounts down-funnel. - Own events and conferences as a first-class pipeline channel: choose the right rooms to be in, show up with a point of view, and convert conversations into pipeline. - Own the full funnel from lead to opportunity, including MQL definitions, lead scoring, nurture flows, and a sales handoff process that doesn't let pipeline leak. - Inform the enterprise-level thought leadership and content strategy, and turn this into assets that are both sales-ready and amplified by paid programs. - Be a genuine partner to SDRs and AEs: align on ICP, co-own pipeline targets, and show up to deal reviews ready to move things forward. - Build the attribution and tracking infrastructure that gives every campaign a clear ROI story — UTMs, dashboards, multi-touch models. We're Looking for People Who Have - 5+ years in B2B marketing with real ownership of enterprise demand generation - A track record of building pipeline programs, from the scrappy to the $$$ - Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation - A sharp understanding of how enterprise buying actually works: committees, champions, multi-thread outreach, and long cycles. - Strong all-around instincts, especially when it comes to what drives conversion - Experience at a company navigating the PLG-to-enterprise transition

jobgether-jobgether:lever:28041050-448b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design - Product Platform based in Canada. This is a senior design leadership role focused on shaping the shared product platform that connects multiple product experiences into one coherent system. You will lead a team of product designers while remaining hands-on with high-impact, complex, and ambiguous design challenges. The role combines strong product craft with systems thinking, strategic design leadership, and close partnership with Product and Engineering. You will influence how customers navigate products, manage access and data, move through workflows, and interact with shared capabilities such as reporting, AI, and design systems. A key part of the role is creating consistency across interconnected product areas while enabling teams to move faster through reusable patterns and thoughtful design decisions. You will also help evolve a shared design system and champion AI-native product thinking and AI-assisted design practices. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced design leader who enjoys developing people, influencing across organizational boundaries, and setting a high bar for enterprise product experiences. Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, including senior individual contributors, while helping team members expand their scope, judgment, and leadership capabilities. Define the product design strategy and quality standards for shared platform experiences in close partnership with Product and Engineering leadership. Operate as a player-coach by personally tackling high-leverage, technically complex, or ambiguous design challenges while empowering designers to own their domains. Establish and maintain a high bar for interaction and visual design across complex, systems-oriented product experiences. Apply systems thinking to platform decisions, identifying cross-product dependencies, opportunities for shared patterns, and ways to create a more cohesive customer experience. Represent Design in roadmap planning, prioritization, product strategy, and architectural discussions. Build alignment and drive decisions across teams through influence, collaboration, and strong communication rather than direct authority. Use customer research, product data, and other customer signals to inform platform strategy and validate design decisions. Drive the adoption, consistency, and continued evolution of the shared design system across product teams. Champion AI-native product thinking and the effective use of AI-assisted design practices across the design organization. Partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to translate technical constraints, architecture considerations, and data models into effective product decisions. Help ensure shared platform patterns improve product consistency, accelerate delivery, and create a seamless experience across interconnected products and workflows. Contribute directly to high-quality design work and help establish the overall craft bar for the design organization. Requirements 8+ years of professional product design experience, including work on complex, systems-level, platform, infrastructure-adjacent, or enterprise products. 3+ years of experience managing product designers, including senior-level individual contributors, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent and expand team capabilities. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent product craft, systems thinking, and the ability to simplify technically complex experiences. Strong visual and interaction design judgment, with experience establishing and maintaining quality standards across a design team. Demonstrated experience setting design strategy across interconnected product areas and driving cohesive experiences across multiple teams. jobgether-jobgether:lever:85dbea93-9abd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Estonia. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality impr

jobgether-jobgether:lever:de86d8fa-9089-.title: Garnishment Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:de86d8fa-9089-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Garnishment Specialist based in the United States. This is a fully remote opportunity focused on ensuring employees’ wage garnishments are processed accurately, compliantly, and on time. You will manage garnishment orders from setup through processing while ensuring payroll systems reflect applicable legal requirements. The role combines payroll knowledge, regulatory research, analytical problem-solving, and customer service. You will investigate processing issues, maintain garnishment rules, and help ensure automated workflows operate effectively. The position involves collaboration with courts, agencies, employees, legal contacts, and internal teams. You will work in a deadline-driven environment where accuracy, organization, discretion, and attention to detail are essential. This is an opportunity to develop deeper expertise in payroll compliance, garnishments, and payroll technology. Review, set up, and maintain wage garnishment orders, including preparing orders and related correspondence for processing and scanning. Maintain garnishment rules within the payroll system by researching applicable state requirements and testing withholding calculations with senior payroll systems specialists. Ensure employee wage withholdings are calculated and processed accurately according to garnishment type, legal requirements, and applicable deadlines. Create, review, and process reports used to automate answer letters and interrogatory responses. Maintain garnishment records and enter appropriate start and stop dates based on court orders and other legal documentation. Resolve payroll and garnishment questions from courts, agencies, employees, and other stakeholders by providing accurate and timely information. Collaborate with internal departments and external contacts, including collection agencies, courts, and legal representatives, to investigate and resolve issues. Process lump-sum payments and coordinate with agencies to determine appropriate withholding amounts for bonuses, annual or quarterly payments, and other lump-sum compensation. Troubleshoot processing automation failures and analyze issues to ensure garnishment workflows operate effectively. Participate in special projects, including account reconciliations, accruals, journal entries, and cross-training activities. Maintain professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive employee, payroll, and legal information. Manage multiple priorities and meet established service-level deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy. Requirements General knowledge of payroll functions and processing, including bookkeeping, payroll taxes, fringe benefits, and wage garnishments. Experience or familiarity with garnishment processing, payroll administration, or related compliance activities is highly relevant. Proficiency with PC-based spreadsheet applications and standard office technology. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and determine appropriate solutions. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain procedures, obtain information, and communicate professionally with different stakeholders. Ability to research and interpret legal or regulatory requirements and translate them into appropriate payroll system actions. Customer-service orientation and the ability to remain professional and constructive when dealing with challenging situations or resistance. Process-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:b4f9fcdf-5fb.description: Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all. About the Role Hinge is looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Global Brand Marketing team. In this role, you'll independently steer integrated brand campaigns across our global markets — owning the full arc from brief through launch and bringing as much strategic curiosity to the work as organizational rigor. You'll shape campaign briefs as a thought partner to Strategy and Creative, lead relationships with external agency partners, and serve as a sounding board for the Sr. Director on where the brand shows up and why. You have a point of view on what makes a campaign earn its place in culture, and you're accountable for making sure the work that launches lives up to it. You report to the Sr. Director, Global Brand Marketing. This is an individual contributor role.
responsibilities: Independently steer integrated brand campaigns with minimal oversight, owning the arc from brief through launch.

Shape campaign briefs and go-to-market plans as a thought partner to Strategy, contributing business context, consumer feedback, and performance insight — and carrying the agreed strategic intent through to launch.

Bring brand and go-to-market expertise to marketing initiatives led by other teams, contributing strategic perspective, channel fluency, and creative judgment where it's needed.
Stay attuned to cultural, consumer, and competitive trends, bringing curiosity about culture to every campaign you touch.

southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:d63dc75b.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. What You’ll Do In this role you will - Own the Full Sales Cycle: Take qualified opportunities from SDRs and your own outreach and lead them through discovery, solutioning, negotiation, and close with a focus on delivering value at every stage. - Drive New Business and Expand Existing Accounts: Convert qualified leads into customers, then grow those accounts by identifying upsell opportunities, new use cases, and wider adoption. - Execute Strategic Outreach: Collaborate with SDRs on targeted outreach strategies, account prioritization, and follow-up to ensure a steady flow of high-quality pipeline. - Communicate Value to Senior Stakeholders: Deliver clear, tailored pitches decision-makers, aligning product capabilities with business needs. - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with permitting, marketing and product teams to shape demos, proposals, and customer experiences that drive results. - Continuously Improve: Share insights from the field to help refine messaging, evolve the product, and strengthen sales processes. - Hit Your Number: Consistently meet or exceed your revenue targets while maintaining strong forecast accuracy and a focus on long-term customer success. Need to have - Consistent top performer in previous organizations - 4+ years of AE Experience - Experience with some sales methodology (MEDDPICC, BANT, Sandler, etc) - Team player mentality, adept at working cross-functionally and within sales org - Clear-eyed regarding the hustle, attitude, intellectual curiosity and flexibility needed to thrive in an early stage environment - Great communicator with exceptional writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, paired with strong organization and time management to effectively manage priorities and build trust across stakeholders. - Hybrid schedule - In office Monday and Wednesday in FiDi. Nice to haves - Has worked into construction or construction-adjacent industry - Early stage startup experience - Eager to work hybrid in Manhattan
